function pattern(flags: string, constructor: unknown): RegExp {
  const expression = /a/g;
  Object.defineProperty(expression, "flags", { get() { console.log("flags"); return flags; } });
  Object.defineProperty(expression, "constructor", { get() { console.log("constructor"); return constructor; } });
  return expression;
}

console.log("matchAll", Array.from("aba".matchAll(pattern("g", RegExp))).length);
console.log("split", "aba".split(pattern("g", RegExp)));
try {
  "a".matchAll(pattern("", RegExp));
} catch (error) {
  console.log(String(error));
}
try {
  "a".matchAll(pattern("g", 7));
} catch (error) {
  console.log(String(error));
}
try {
  "a".split(pattern("g", 7));
} catch (error) {
  console.log(String(error));
}
